digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner / Pass-1 execution / usage aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 call usage is currently discarded by passes.pass1_chunk/pass1_container/pass1_isf (returning findings lists only), so BatchRunResult.outputs lacks usage data and plan-review coverage.metrics has no token totals for Pass-1
Per-criterion request counts are extracted but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions
Usage is threaded through passes.pass1_* functions and run_focused_finder as return-value pairs (findings + usage dict / text + usage dict) with every caller updated atomically
Multi-criterion chunks divide token fields equally across covered criteria while llm_calls and requests count in full per criterion; ladder-retry attempts each contribute one call record
Completed attempts contribute usage records; raising attempts and checkpoint-served chunks contribute nothing (zero usage, no record)

The batch runner aggregates per-call usage into per-criterion maps and emits them in BatchRunResult.outputs['_usage'], _attach_plan_review_metrics folds token totals into coverage.metrics, and sidecar.build_payload exposes coverage.usage with per_call and per_criterion keys
